verdict.rationale: Nix's own declarative model acts on many items at once. A whole system configuration, kernel and packages included, is built or rolled back as one unit (nix-docs-27, nix-docs-46, nix-docs-7), and a single config can describe a fleet of servers (nix-docs-63). The garbage collector removes all unused packages in one pass (nix-docs-6), one expression can be parameterized and called any number of times (nix-docs-62), and a user reports building lots of Docker images with Nix (nix-comm-10). Missing for 10: a documented bulk command for selecting or upgrading many items (the upgrade example targets a single attribute), explicit bulk-operation documentation aimed at agent or programmatic workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk use at scale.
